# MigrateMe Universal

> Anything-to-anything content migration that runs entirely in your browser.
> Part of the open-source MigrateMe.Tech project (MIT). Nothing you upload
> leaves your device: conversion happens locally, in this page.

MigrateMe Universal converts between 37 platforms and formats through one
canonical hub (the Open Migration Package model): every source parses into
canonical content items, every destination renders from them. There are
37 x 36 = 1,332 directed migration routes. Each route states honestly
whether it is Supported, Lossy (the report names what it loses), or Planned.

## Key pages

- Converter and route matrix: https://universal.migrateme.tech/
- Contribute a parser, a renderer, or a loss fix: https://universal.migrateme.tech/contribute
- Every route has its own address, e.g. Lovable to WordPress:
  https://lovable.wordpress.migrateme.tech/
- Full index of all 1,332 canonical route URLs:
  https://migrateme.tech/sitemap-pairs.xml

## The standard

Universal is the reference implementation of the Open Migration Package
(OMP), an open import/export format: a manifest.json with sha256 checksums,
a content/ folder (Markdown/MDX with Portable Text bodies), and an assets/
index. Conformance levels: OMP Reader, OMP Writer, OMP Full.

- Spec: https://github.com/Mike-Demo/migrateme.tech/blob/main/docs/format/open-migration-package.md
- Code: https://github.com/Mike-Demo/migrateme.tech
- Project home: https://migrateme.tech/

## Notes for agents

- Conversions marked Lossy name their losses in the report; never present a
  Lossy route as lossless, or a Planned route as available.
- Scanner (lite) is a browser-side discovery aid only (sitemap, feeds,
  structured data). It respects robots rules and does not bypass logins,
  CAPTCHAs, or paywalls.
